self-service.title: Blueprint self-service
self-service.description: Whether the blueprint is published in the self-service catalog. Either a boolean, which applies to every space the repository is connected to, or a list of the space names to publish the blueprint in (space names are case insensitive, and spaces that are not listed are left unpublished). Once this field is set, it can no longer be changed through the API or the UI in any space.

service_account.description: Email of the service account whose identity the environment's auto-minted Torque API token assumes. The presence of this section with a non-empty service_account requests API access.

TemplateParamsObject.description: Static template params exposed as params.* in Liquid expressions.
TemplateParamsObject.title: Template Params

key.description: Taint key that the toleration applies to. Omit together with an 'Exists' operator to tolerate all taints.

operator.description: 'Equal' matches the taint key to the given value, 'Exists' matches the key regardless of its value.

value.description: Taint value to match. Required when the operator is 'Equal'.

effect.description: Taint effect to tolerate. Leave empty to tolerate all effects.

toleration-seconds.description: For a 'NoExecute' taint, how long the pod stays bound to the node after the taint is added.

description.description: In the relevant UI field, enter a description to be displayed to the user.

default.description: Pre-fills the launch-form field; never affects required-ness (required = no 'pattern'). A non-empty default must itself satisfy the pattern. 'default: ""' is a real empty-string default on a still-required field, not 'optional' - use a '^$|' pattern for that.

sensitive.description: Masks the value in UI and API. The launch form pre-fills sensitive inputs empty regardless of any default, so a sensitive input is only optional with an empty-matching pattern.

pattern.description: Regex for the value, enforced client-side in the launch form. The form marks an input REQUIRED if and only if it has no pattern; to make an input optional (blank allowed), use a pattern that matches the empty string - convention: a leading '^$|' alternative. Note that 'default: ""' does NOT make an input optional.

validation-description.description: Message shown when the value fails 'pattern' (e.g. 'Empty or a URL').

searchable.description: When true, indicates that the input source supports search. The UI will collect a search pattern from the user before querying allowed values.

target_name.description: Reserved override: a Target name whose Discovery-capability credential/agent the evaluation uses instead of explicit credential/agent overrides.

resource-selector.description: Selection criteria constraining which inventory resources may be chosen for an input of type 'resource'. Mandatory for 'resource' inputs. Field values may use Liquid expressions.

sensitive.description: True if the output value is sensitive (e.g. a password). Affects only how the value is displayed in the UI - the value itself is still sent as-is.

selector.description: Selection criteria constraining which inventory resources may be chosen for the requirement

oneOf.description: One or more inventory resource reference ids to reserve for the requirement, as a single reference id or a JSON-array string of reference ids. Liquid expressions are allowed.

ids.description: A single resource reference id or a JSON-array string of reference ids. Liquid expressions are allowed.

ResourceSelectorBaseObject.$comment: Shared selection criteria for resource selectors, inherited via allOf by referencing objects. Deliberately does not set 'additionalProperties', so that it stays open for the inheritors to extend.

ResourceSelectorObject.$comment: Extends ResourceSelectorBaseObject with 'quantity'. The inherited properties are re-listed here with empty schemas ({}) only so that 'additionalProperties': false does not reject them: 'additionalProperties' considers only the 'properties' declared in the same schema object and is blind to those coming from the $ref'd base. If this schema is ever moved to draft 2019-09 or later, delete these stubs and replace 'additionalProperties': false with 'unevaluatedProperties': false.
ResourceSelectorObject.title: Blueprint Resource Selector

BlueprintInputResourceSelectorObject.$comment: Extends ResourceSelectorBaseObject, adding no fields of its own - notably no 'quantity', which is a resource-requirement concern. See the $comment on ResourceSelectorObject for why the inherited properties are re-listed with empty schemas ({}).
BlueprintInputResourceSelectorObject.title: Blueprint Input Resource Selector

inputs.description: Legacy: input customizations directly under customization.

layout.description: Dynamic environment dashboard layout (cards/categories). Loosely validated.

grains-map.description: Designer canvas layout (node positions, groups, notes). Typically generated by the Torque designer, not hand-written.

image.description: Image URL (https:// or data:image/) shown on the launch form.

httpmethod.description: HTTP method for the action: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE or PATCH (case-insensitive). Defaults to GET.

name.description: The name of the input field

header.description: Comma separated header for object input type

allow-refresh.description: Show or hide refresh button next to Input-Source type input

visible.description: Conditional visibility expression using Liquid template syntax

display_name.description: Display name override for the input.

allowed-values-details.description: Per-allowed-value details map (value -> details object), or a list of such maps.

visible.description: Step visibility flag or Liquid expression

name.description: The display name of the category

description.description: Descriptive text shown under the category

LaunchFormSectionObject.description: A section whose inputs are all 'visible: false' still renders as an empty header - keep at least one visible input in it, or remove the section.

name.description: The display name of the section

description.description: Descriptive text shown under the section

default_open.description: Whether the section should be expanded by default

type.description: Special section type, for example duration

LaunchFormSectionObject.title: Launch Form Section Object

cloud-providers.description: Filter targets by cloud provider type (e.g. aws, azure). OR logic

cloud-identifiers.description: Filter targets by cloud account identifier. OR logic

labels.description: Filter targets by labels. AND logic — target must have ALL specified key-value label pairs.
